{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Annihilator}}
A '''hypermatter reactor''', also called a '''hypermatter annihilator''', was a type of [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]] that created enormous amounts of power by destroying [[Hypermatter/Legends|hypermatter]].<ref name="SW:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref><ref name="DSn">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>

==History==
Most spacecraft were equipped with different models of hypermatter annihilator reactors for traveling through hyperspace.<ref name="AOTC:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> The [[Porax-38 starfighter]] was representative of the long-range [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] that utilized hypermatter reactors.<ref name="ROTS:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> In the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Stars]], the reactor was fueled by many stellar fuel bottles that lined its rim.<ref name="SW:ICS" /><ref name="DBDS">{{DB|location|deathstar|Death Star}}</ref>
